notes: Suggested ground-truth points derived automatically from the current runtime anchor layout.
These are intended to reduce manual XYZ planning effort.
Use floor tape, string, or simple measuring tape to approximate these points physically.

points.label: P1_center_floor
points.placement_hint: Intersection of the two floor diagonals: line A-C and line B-D.

points.label: P2_center_mid
points.placement_hint: Same XY as the room center, Tag held around the middle between lower and upper planes.

points.label: P3_center_high
points.placement_hint: Same XY as the room center, Tag held clearly below the upper anchors.

points.label: P8_under_E_floor
points.placement_hint: Approximate floor projection of upper anchor E.

points.label: P9_under_G_floor
points.placement_hint: Approximate floor projection of upper anchor G.

points.label: P10_left_face_center_approx
points.placement_hint: Approximate intersection/center defined by the two 3D face diagonals A-H and D-E, using a small rack or frame.

points.label: P11_right_face_center_approx
points.placement_hint: Approximate intersection/center defined by the two 3D face diagonals B-G and C-F.

points.label: P12_front_face_center_approx
points.placement_hint: Approximate intersection/center defined by the two 3D face diagonals A-F and B-E.

points.label: P13_back_face_center_approx
points.placement_hint: Approximate intersection/center defined by the two 3D face diagonals D-G and C-H.

points.label: P14_top_face_center
points.placement_hint: Approximate intersection/center of the upper face diagonals E-G and F-H.

points.label: P15_volume_center_approx
points.placement_hint: Approximate room volume center from the current anchor layout.
